Definition of Done
100% Tier 1 Coverage

All "Critical Level 1" processes with Inventory traced to the line of code.

Bidirectional Traceability

Each behavior linked to a source Unquestionable evidence. Zero rules deduced without ballast.

Human Validation (PR Review)

Opacity isolation

Like As-Is Molda the To-Be

The Discovery Baseline feeds each migration decision with exact answers: what to preserve, redesign or discontinue.

Withheld (Migrade As-Is)

Intact Preservation

Components that work properly and have low risk. Migrates without logical change to the new architecture.

Refactored

Sustained Logic, Tech Changed

Business rule preserved, but modernized implementation. Ex: Workflow Legacy rule → Modern Flow/Appex with scenarios Parity BDD.

Discontinued

Obsolete Code Deleted

Zombie code, historical workarounds and worthless features. Safely removed thanks full traceability of the inventory.

Parity BDD Tests

Scenes Given-When-Then extracted become the set Regression officer. If the new architecture passes all the BDD tests in the previous environment, the business parity is guaranteed.

Dependencies Map points to systemic borders ideal for incremental monolith shutdown — without breaking external references Or interrupt operations.

Fail-Closed Governance: The model requires a technical leader to validate the inventory via Pull Request. No artifact generated IA continues without explicit human approval — mitigating 99% of the risk of hallucinations leaking for To-Be requirements.

Critical Analysis · Total Transparency

Evaluation of Risks and Sureties

Questioning assumptions and anticipating frictions to design a resilient implementation.

Solid & Proven

  • Breakup Discovery vs. Doc Alive: "As-Is" frozen as project with start, middle and end works brilliantly in refactoring.
  • Fail-Closed Governance: Review via PR mitiga 99% the risk of hallucinations in To-Be requirements.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Local navigation dramatically reduces costs vs. copying entire repository to the LLM context.

It's still Hypothesis

  • Complex Apex proficiency: LLMs are spectacular with Python/JS, but Governor Limits, SOQL in Loops and legacy patterns of Trigger can cause initial interpretation errors.
  • Causal discovery can confuse local and global impact on Trigger Handlers 20,000+ lines complex.

Open Decisions

  • & IP Data Processing: Metadata with IIP hardcoded and sensitive commercial rules require Enterprise/Zero-Retention API layer by Anthropic/OpenAI.
  • Processing Cost: Hard caps per pipeline of analysis needs to be defined before execution in scale.

In short

What is Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI

Before modernizing (To-Be), it is necessary freeze a high-fidelity photo of what the system really does today (As-Is). Critical knowledge usually lives hidden — in Apex, fragmented Flows and in the head of a few. Modernizing without mapping is erasing vital rules without knowing.

  • Discovery guided by journeys — starts from a business journey and follows the execution trail, isolating the dead code.
  • Evidence Matrix — crosses structural, state, operational and human inputs to avoid false-positive.
  • Behavior Inventory — core rules, side effects and workarounds, classified by trust.
  • As-Is → contracts — the audited inventory becomes the raw material of validation schemas.

It's the pillar. M1 (Map) ed Trust Engineering.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What is AI assisted reverse engineering?

It is the use of AI to reveal and freeze, with high fidelity, the actual behavior of a legacy system (the As-Is) before modernizing it. The goal is not to generate eternal documentation, but an auditable inventory for architects to decide what to preserve, redesign or discontinue.

Why freeze the As-Is before modernizing?

Because every legacy system suffers from "tribal" knowledge: rules that sustain business but that nobody wrote. Modernizing without mapping erases vital rules without knowing — High fidelity As-Is is the security network of transformation.

What's the best discovery strategy?

The discovery guided by critical journeys and risk (top-down with deep dive): starts from a business journey, follows the execution trail (call stack) and maps every component it touches. This quickly isolates the dead code, which belongs to no journey.

What is the Evidence Matrix?

It is a multifaceted pool that avoids false-positive: structural inputs (metadata, Apex, Flows), state (Custom Metadata/Settings), operational (Event Monitoring, Debug Logs, which reveal zombie code) and human (commits, tickets, interviews, which give the why of the rule).

What is the Behavioral Inventory?

It is the final asset of mapping: not a catalogue of IFs/ELSEs, but core rules, side effects and historical workarounds, each classified by the trust of evidence. He is the raw material of the validation contracts of the next phase.
